'''Mullanite''' was a type of [[Vine/Legends|vine]]-like [[Plant/Legends|plant]]<ref name="GSWU" /> present on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rudrig/Legends|Rudrig]]. Mullanite's tendency for creeping along surfaces led some artists to create [[Mullanite lattice-sculpture]]s.<ref name="HSLL" />
